MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked every endpoint, type, fact, limit and the stop. The e-stop and safe-state action were the hector landing action, which is not a stop: each landing goal starts a pose goal that first calls enableMotors(true) (pose_action.cpp:56-58); one e-stop sent it twice (native stop and safe_state=True action, probed), switching a landed UAV's motors on again; any non-zero cmd_vel preempts the position control it waits on (velocity_controller.cpp:173-181), and the multi-MAV launches' behaviour node publishes one at 10 Hz; and it can take 30 s. The four cmd_vel limits cited YAML lines that state only an xy magnitude, a z clamp and the attitude yawrate clamp (four UNSOURCED_LIMIT_GATE_WARNINGs accepted by the author), and four facts said more than their lines. The reviewer removed the e-stop binding, safe_state=True and estop_latency_ms, made the limits operator_required, rewrote safe_state, the docstring and the gaps, corrected four facts and added twelve (driver.py); replaced the landing e-stop cases with one expecting SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, no upstream call and the latch held, plus LIMITS_UNSET and overlay cases (test_driver.py); updated site-limits.example.json and facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 (stable digest sha256:52ac12a005d8062bc786a5d7c6cf5633cc0abc2acf32f5fbae3d4284ef4d8f10), the 13 cases pass; the author's notes on the landing e-stop and the sourced limits are superseded. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Simulation only (hector_quadrotor, Gazebo); no real-vehicle path in the clone. After the latch the UAV is not stopped: alone, the attitude controller's 0.5 s command timeout ramps the thrust down (an unsensed descent); with the behaviour node it keeps flying. That node's system("pkill -f ros") kills every host process whose command line contains ros, including an mhs serve of this package.

MODEL REVIEW (grok-4.7, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Repair of the landing e-stop the previous model review removed. The stop is /gazebo/pause_physics (std_srvs/Empty, success path $ equals {}), confirmed by /gazebo/get_physics_properties when pause equals true (driver.py safety_bindings; companion gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:462-468, :1662-1666 SetPaused(true), :1426 res.pause = world_->IsPaused()). unpausePhysics at :1668-1672 is not bound. No re-enable. twist_command_.twist is stored at velocity_controller.cpp:169; update() applies it at :207 and stamps attitude, yawrate and thrust with that stored header.stamp at :265-267. The stamp does not advance, so the attitude controller command_timeout (params.yaml:4 is 0.5; attitude_controller.cpp:154-157) can drop those outputs after 0.5 s of simulation time, and it does not clear twist_command_. The behaviour node publishes cmd_vel again at behaviour.cpp:577 and sleeps on ros::Rate at :591-592. safe_state names the recovery: stop those nodes and clear the stored twist outside MHS, then unpause. This driver does not unpause. The resource read is empty; /uav1/ground_truth/state stays the explicit odometry read, and the fake returns no sample while paused. The cmd_vel receipt adds sent_linear_x, sent_linear_y, sent_linear_z and sent_angular_z (driver.py _SentReceipt); they are the transmitted request, not a measurement. enable_motors stays ordinary: enableMotorsCallback at quadrotor_hardware_gazebo.cpp:274-278 returns true, and enableMotors sets motor_status_.running at :280-283. writeSim applies a wrench only while motor_status_.on and motor_status_.running (:247), from the gazebo_ros_control world-update begin hook, which World::Step does not run while paused (World.cc:691-710). The API plugin AsyncSpinner (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:149-151) can still answer that service on wall time while paused. Landing stays ordinary: pose_action.cpp:56-58 calls enableMotors(true); the fake returns action status 4 while paused and does not set landed or clear motors.
